Ava (CSM): FYI account AR-927 is heating up — onboarding stalled at integration step, renewal in 28 days. risk score jumped to 82% :warning:
Sam G: thanks, can you paste the latest health dashboard snippet?
Ava (CSM): copied from console: 
```
health.overall: 0.62
onboarding.progress: 0.45
api.success_rate: 0.88
recent.support.tickets: 3
last_engagement: 12d
```
Jordan C: onboarding.progress under 0.5 + last_engagement >10d = high churn risk. we should run a "rescue enablement" call this week.
Priya R: I can take the enablement call Wed 10am PT. I'll prepare a targeted checklist: integration logs, API keys, sample traffic profile, quick demo of retry/backoff.
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll join for 30m to diagnose their integration errors. Ava, can you share the most recent error logs?
Ava (CSM): pasted a redacted snippet: `ERROR 503 backend_timeout /v1/infer` and several rate_limit warnings. Also customer mentioned tokenization mismatch in chat responses.
Sam G: sounds like two parallel tracks: ops (errors/limits) + product enablement (integration patterns). recommend opening a tiered save plan: 1) immediate connector fix + quick patch, 2) scheduled enablement session, 3) 2-week follow-up and usage uplift goals.
Jordan C: add a downgrade-safety net: if they still hit quota issues after patch, offer a temporary burst credit and a guided quantization profile to lower unit costs. Communicate this as "stability-first" to avoid sounding like a discount.
Priya R: proposed enablement agenda (short):
- 5m intros + renewal context
- 10m current integration walkthrough (logs)
- 10m patch walkthrough (Ben)
- 10m next steps + success metrics (Ava)
Sam G: I'll draft an email template to the customer. Ava, you own outreach. Use subject: "Quick stability session + renewal check-in" and attach the health snapshot.
Ava (CSM): outreach scheduled for Tue EOD. adding playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/churn/rescue-compact (internal)
CSM Bot: Reminder: Use `churn_save` tag on the account and set task:enablement_call -> owner=Priya R, due=2026-03-25
Ben (Solutions Eng): heads-up — if backend_timeout persists, we should escalate to eng-runtime for kernel-level trace. Sam, can you open a runbook incident if we see >5 errors/hr?
Sam G: will do. also adding tracking fields in the CRM: status=at_risk, next_call=2026-03-25T17:00:00Z, proposed_credit=1d_burst
Ava (CSM): thanks team. quick win: Priya, Ben, please confirm you're both on the Wed call. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
Priya R: confirmed.
Ben (Solutions Eng): confirmed.
Jordan C: I'll prepare a short renewal-risk note for Rev Ops so they don't auto-escalate to collections.
Ava (CSM): final note — capture customer feedback in the post-call form (link: https://redwood.internal/forms/enablement-feedback). want to record sentiment + blockers to feed Optimize suggestions.
Sam G: agreed. tagging this thread with `#churn-prevent` and saving runbook steps to the shared doc.
Ava (CSM): perfect. closing here once the enablement call is complete and we have follow-up artifacts. :white_check_mark:
